ccModel Object

Source: R/25-DEGAS_Screen.R
ccModel-class.Rd

ccModel Object

Slots

Bias

A list containing bias terms for each layer of the model.

Theta

A list of parameter matrices/vectors for the model.

Activation

A list of activation functions for each layer.

Depth

Numeric. The number of layers in the model architecture. Must be a positive integer.

Model_type

Character. The type of model

Architecture

Character. Description of the model architecture

References

Johnson TS, Yu CY, Huang Z, Xu S, Wang T, Dong C, et al. Diagnostic Evidence GAuge of Single cells (DEGAS): a flexible deep transfer learning framework for prioritizing cells in relation to disease. Genome Med. 2022 Feb 1;14(1):11.

Examples

# Create a simple ccModel object
model <- new("ccModel",
  Bias = list(c(0.1, 0.2), c(0.3)),
  Theta = list(matrix(c(0.5, 0.6), nrow=1), matrix(c(0.7), nrow=1)),
  Activation = list("relu", "sigmoid"),
  Depth = 2,
  Model_type = "neural_network",
  Architecture = "feedforward"
)
